original_title: US envoy Witkoff coached Russia to pitch a Ukraine peace plan to Trump

ai_analysis.detailed_analysis: Diplomatic backchannel communications reveal US envoy coaching Russian officials on peace plan negotiations, potentially undermining official US policy. The leaked transcript suggests possible unauthorized diplomatic engagement that could complicate Ukraine conflict resolution efforts and create policy confusion.
ai_analysis.immediate_forecast_24h: Increased diplomatic tensions between US and Ukraine; potential for information warfare escalation; possible denial/disavowal statements from US officials
ai_analysis.strategic_outlook: Potential erosion of US-Ukraine alliance credibility; risk of conflicting diplomatic messages creating operational confusion; possible exploitation by Russia to drive wedge between allies
ai_analysis.operational_impact: Increased scrutiny of diplomatic communications; potential need to verify official policy positions; possible temporary freeze in certain diplomatic channels until clarity is established
